title: Give What You Have Received
verse: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, stand up and walk!
observation: I have talked to many Christians who are intimidated by the world around them. They see people hurting and feel so inadequate to help. They also realize they do not have life figured out yet either and end up feeling as though they are not up to the task of being God’s “hands and feet” in their world. Today’s passage reminds us that we are not supposed to be everyone’s savior. We are supposed to point them to the One who is. Peter and John could have said they were not up to the task because they were not Jesus. Instead, they said they could give only what they have received and that was enough. Today, do not see your world as something you have to save. Instead, see the world as a place where you can point people to Jesus. He is the Savior. We are the messengers.
application: Today, share with someone the hope you have received.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the true Savior of the world.
